gore_warning.ballisticmissiles.title: WARNING – ADULTS ONLY
gore_warning.ballisticmissiles.text:
Ballistic Missiles shows extreme, highly realistic and disturbing violence: open gunshot wounds, arms and legs torn off with bone exposed, skulls blown open with brain matter, people and animals torn to pieces by explosions, organs lying about, slowly bleeding out and dying.

This content is intended for adults aged 18 and over only. It can be upsetting or shocking - for adults too. If you are under 18, find this kind of thing distressing or are unsure, turn gore off now. The game works without it.

Gore can be switched on and off at any time in the mod settings.
gore_warning.ballisticmissiles.alpha:
⚠ ALPHA VERSION: this mod is still VERY, VERY much a work in progress. Much is unfinished and may change or break. Many more updates are coming!

☣ The GORE SYSTEM is only PRE-ALPHA: right at the start, very unfinished – expect bugs, display problems and big changes.
